name: Maximilian Gruber
bio:
Maximilian's journey into motorsport started with a fascination for the intricate liveries on racing cars. He spent countless hours meticulously detailing model cars as a child, a hobby that evolved into an apprenticeship at a local automotive body shop. There, he honed his skills in paint application, color matching, and surface preparation. Seeing the opportunity to combine his passion with his profession, he applied for a role at Target Racing, quickly proving his worth with his keen eye for detail and unwavering commitment to achieving a flawless finish. Maximilian is known for his exacting standards; any imperfection, no matter how minor, is unacceptable, driving him to consistently deliver exceptional results. He believes that a perfect paint job isn't just cosmetic; it's a crucial element of a car's identity and a reflection of the team's dedication to excellence.

At Target Racing, Maximilian is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the paint shop, from preparing surfaces to applying the final clear coat. He is particularly adept at working with complex multi-layered designs and ensuring color consistency across different panels. He is also constantly researching new painting techniques and materials to improve the durability and aesthetic appeal of the team's vehicles. While sometimes perceived as demanding, Maximilian's pursuit of perfection ultimately benefits the entire team, ensuring that their cars always look their best on the track. His ambition is to become the head paint specialist for a leading Formula 1 team, showcasing his skills on the world's biggest motorsport stage.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight quiff.
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height with a lean build and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always wears latex gloves, even when not directly handling paint.
Carries a small magnifying glass to inspect paint finishes.
Plays classical music in the paint shop to maintain a calm and focused atmosphere.
